name: Naralex
summary: Beneath the Barrens, Naralex sleeps while his dream of green turns to nightmare. The night elf druid sought to restore the parched land through the Emerald Dream, but corruption overtook his slumber and twisted his followers into venomous fiends.

sections.title: A Vision of Green
sections.body: Naralex came to the Barrens with devoted disciples, hoping to restore the forest that covered the plains before the Great Sundering. Beneath the savannah, he found underground springs and rushing geysers. He named the caverns for the howling wind and steam that moaned through the rock. He believed a deep trance could channel the Emerald Dream into those waters, carrying life to the surface and making the wasteland bloom.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: Deep in the caverns, Naralex entered meditation and reached toward the Emerald Dream. Corruption ensnared his mind instead of the peaceful wild nature he sought. The Emerald Nightmare seized the sleeping druid and made him a conduit for dark energies to enter the living world. Springs turned foul, fungal blooms mutated, and the caverns' beasts became ravenous horrors.

sections.title: Fallen Disciples
sections.body: The Emerald Nightmare's corruption drove Naralex's disciples mad through the psychic backlash of his trance. They abandoned the Cenarion Circle's traditions, took serpent forms, and named themselves the Druids of the Fang. Believing their twisted growth should spread across Kalimdor, they guard Naralex's sleeping body to keep him from waking. A few loyal disciples still seek allies brave enough to break the trance.

faq.answer: Naralex is a night elf druid of the Cenarion Circle who led an expedition into the Wailing Caverns. He hoped to draw on the Emerald Dream and restore the arid Barrens to the forest that stood there before the Sundering.

faq.q: Why is Naralex asleep inside the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: Naralex entered a meditative trance to channel the Emerald Dream into aquifers beneath the Barrens. A nightmare seized his mind and trapped him in a fevered slumber he cannot escape alone.

faq.q: What created the Druids of the Fang?
aliases: who are druids of the fang
faq.answer: The Druids of the Fang were once Naralex's faithful disciples. The Emerald Nightmare corrupted his connection to the Dream, and its malice drove them mad. They left the Cenarion Circle, took serpent forms, and guard Naralex's slumber so the corruption can spread.

faq.q: What caused the Wailing Caverns to mutate?
faq.answer: Naralex's sleeping body became a conduit for the Emerald Nightmare, whose foul energies seeped into the underground waters. The caverns' plants, crocodiles, raptors, and serpents were warped into aggressive deviate mutants.
Yes. A loyal Disciple of Naralex works with adventurers willing to enter the depths, defeat the twisted Druids of the Fang, and perform a ritual to break the nightmare's hold on Naralex's mind.

faq.q: Why did Naralex want to change the Barrens?
faq.answer: Naralex learned that the Barrens had once been a flourishing forest before the Great Sundering shattered Kalimdor. He saw the arid land as a wound and hoped to restore its ancient forest.

angles.text: For druids, Naralex's story warns against meddling blindly with primal natural states or reaching too deeply into the Dream without caution. Either can unleash terrible distortions of the wild.
As a night elf, you may see Naralex's effort to heal Kalimdor, yet his ambition in Horde territory disgraced the Cenarion Circle and gave rise to the treacherous Druids of the Fang.
As a tauren, you depend on the oasis pools and wildlife that sustain the tribes of Mulgore and the savannah. The twisted waters beneath the Barrens threaten them.

As a member of the Horde, you face a night elf's failed experiment that has polluted the heart of the Barrens. Horde forces from the Crossroads must contend with rampaging beasts emerging from the caverns.
